name: skynul
description: Skynul - local-first desktop agent with explicit permissions
author: Skynul

scripts.dev:backend: pnpm --dir packages/core exec cargo run --bin skynul-server
scripts.build:unpack: electron-builder install-app-deps && pnpm -s build && pnpm -s pack:prepare && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --dir
scripts.build:win: electron-builder install-app-deps && pnpm -s build && pnpm -s pack:prepare && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --publish never
scripts.build:mac: electron-builder install-app-deps && pnpm -s build && pnpm -s pack:prepare && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --mac --publish never
scripts.build:linux: electron-builder install-app-deps && pnpm -s build && pnpm -s pack:prepare && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --linux --publish never
scripts.release:win: electron-builder install-app-deps && pnpm -s build && pnpm -s pack:prepare && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --publish always
scripts.release:mac: pnpm -s build && pnpm -s pack:prepare && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --mac --publish always
scripts.release:linux: pnpm -s build && pnpm -s pack:prepare && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --linux --publish always
